contract.question: 我正在为低轨空间平台上的太阳盲紫外臭氧与高空燃烧羽流探测器设计前端滤光膜。探测器需要尽可能透过 255–280 nm 的太阳盲紫外信号，同时尽可能抑制 300–700 nm 可见光背景和 700–1100 nm 近红外杂散光。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，设计一个不含金属层、仅使用常规可沉积无机介质材料的平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。

revision_plan_audit.diagnosis_text: Baseline P002 shows moderate UV transmission (7.2e-6) but insufficient visible/NIR suppression (0.35/0.83). Local derivatives indicate that decreasing dH1 improves G1, G2, and G3 simultaneously (negative derivatives for all goals), while decreasing dCav improves G2 and G3 but slightly degrades G1. Increasing dL1 improves G2 but degrades G3. The choice to refine layers is driven by the clear local gradient on dH1 which suggests a path to simultaneous improvement in all three objectives by reducing the high-index layer thickness within bounds [40, 60].
revision_plan_audit.at_bound_scope: effective search window only; not a new user physical constraint

goal_gradient_conflicts.interpretation: Opposite local goal directions for the same variable; no claim that a joint multivariable improving step is impossible.

revision_plan_audit.diagnosis_text: Design P018 exhibits significantly higher UV transmission (3.5e-5) compared to P002, confirming the potential of this family configuration for the passband goal. However, it suffers from poor rejection in visible (0.37) and NIR (0.85) bands. Derivatives suggest decreasing dH1 and dCav improves rejection (G2, G3) but at the cost of UV transmission (G1). Refining the family parameters allows exploring the trade-off surface where UV gain might be balanced against rejection needs, specifically testing if the high UV peak can be maintained while widening stopbands via parameter adjustment.
revision_plan_audit.at_bound_scope: effective search window only; not a new user physical constraint

goal_gradient_conflicts.interpretation: Opposite local goal directions for the same variable; no claim that a joint multivariable improving step is impossible.

revision_plan_audit.diagnosis_text: P008 demonstrates excellent rejection in visible (0.25) and NIR (0.80) but very low UV transmission (2.4e-6). Derivatives show that decreasing dH1 improves G3 but worsens G2, while decreasing dCav improves G2 and G3. The conflict between G1 (needs increase) and G2/G3 (needs decrease) is sharp here. Refining individual layers (untying the shared dH1/dL1 variables) is necessary to break the symmetry that forces uniform behavior, potentially allowing specific cavity or mirror layer adjustments to recover UV transmission without sacrificing the achieved rejection levels.

The revision plan says decreasing dH1 improves all P002 goals, but saved P002 per-nm derivatives for minimized G2/G3 are negative; P008 dH1/dCav text has analogous sign reversals in its saved derivative rows.

P002: G2 improves 17/17, G3 16/17, G1 10/17. P018: G3 improves 2/2 and G1/G2 are mixed. P008: G1 improves 13/13 while G2 and G3 each split 7/6; this is a finite sampled tradeoff pattern, not an automatic system failure.
